title: Reply-size analogue using moderate unconnected response demand
purpose: Stimulate reply construction on the unconnected explicit path with a moderate attribute-list request that is larger than minimal but far below the issue's dangerous scale, helping cover response-size and metadata assembly decisions safely.

messages.label: RegisterSession then moderate SendRRData GetAttributeList analogue

expected_behavior: Target should build either a bounded success reply or a normal error reply for the requested attribute list and must keep encapsulation and CPF metadata consistent while doing so.
constraints_preserved: Combined seed contains two sequential encapsulation messages: RegisterSession then SendRRData, each with independent 24-byte headers and correct little-endian lengths.
SendRRData uses Null Address Item plus Unconnected Data Item, matching the documented common CPF combination.
Embedded GetAttributeList-style request uses count 4 with distinct small attribute IDs to request a moderate reply, not an oversized one.
The service code and path encoding are conservative inferred CIP conventions used only to drive realistic parsing, not claimed as source-verified.
issue_safety_notes: This seed stays well below the issue's repeated-80-attribute pattern and omits optional socket-address items, reducing amplification while still probing reply-size handling logic.
